test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Improve the sentence using the correct phrasal verb of the underlined words.

The thieves managed to __get off__ the police during the chase.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **get away from**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"get off"** means to leave or disembark from something, such as a vehicle, or to escape from a situation quickly. (छोड़ना, भागना) • **Example:** She managed to get off the bus just before it left. • **"Get away from"** refers to escaping or evading someone or something, often in a hurried or stealthy manner. (भाग जाना, बच निकलना) • **Example:** The thieves managed to get away from the police during the chase. • Hence, the appropriate phrasal verb to replace "get off" in the sentence is "get away from." Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Get along with** (साथ में अच्छा व्यवहार करना): To have a harmonious or friendly relationship with someone. • **Example:** I get along with my colleagues really well. • **Get over** (पार करना, उबरना): To recover from something, especially a bad experience or illness. • **Example:** It took her months to get over the breakup. • **Get through** (संपन्न करना, पार करना): To successfully complete or survive something difficult. • **Example:** He managed to get through the tough exam with excellent marks. 151:T95e, The correct answer is: **Thrifty**.
